evidence_and_pass_fail.pass: Every applicable proof case returns its expected observable evidence on the exact stable candidate, produced by a session with the authority the case names.
evidence_and_pass_fail.fail: Any command failure, stale candidate identity, missing required rendering, unresolved active terminology, self-certification, or material open gap is FAIL.
evidence_and_pass_fail.inconclusive: Tool unavailability or ambiguous evidence is typed INCONCLUSIVE and cannot become PASS.

evidence_and_pass_fail.independence_rule: Author-produced results, including every entry in author_reported_results, are diagnostic. They never satisfy an assurance gate and are never recorded as independent PASS.

preconditions: README.md, docs/architecture/bearing-delivery-lifecycle.md, docs/guides/, docs/releases/, and the role contracts are complete.
Per DEC-BDL-064 the three standalone process HTML pages are absent and are not part of the required public surface set.
proof_cases.stimulus_or_procedure: Run the documentation and conformance tests, then inspect the current approved public surfaces for one ordered lifecycle, consistent active role and session names, and resolvable internal links.
proof_cases.expected_result: All public surfaces use the same active terms and ordered lifecycle, and every public link resolves to a file that exists.
proof_cases.observable_evidence: Passing CMD-BDL-DOCS output plus an inspection record listing each checked public surface and its resolved links.
proof_cases.pass_fail_rule: PASS only when no stale active role or lifecycle term remains outside explicitly historical material and no public link points at a deleted process HTML page. A failure caused by a missing docs/architecture/bearing-process/*.html file is FAIL against the assertion, not against the deletion, and is repaired by removing the superseded assertion or link.

method_fields.blocking_gap_note: CMD-BDL-DOCS runs test/public-boundary.test.mjs, which currently carries two deleted-HTML failures (GAP-BDL-001) and one package-inventory failure (GAP-BDL-004). All three must clear before this case can PASS.

proof_cases.negative_or_failure_case: Injecting Surveyor, lineups.json, or lifecycle-end wording where phase cadence applies causes a focused test failure; adding a public link to a nonexistent page also fails.

preconditions: profiles schema and migration fixtures exist.
proof_cases.stimulus_or_procedure: Validate valid nested profiles and invalid legacy, cadence, role, and route cases, including the nested role/session activation cases of DEC-BDL-049: sessions illegal for a role are rejected; an explicitly disabled session is accepted; an omitted role or omitted session is accepted as an optional configuration without the schema asserting any runtime enablement.
proof_cases.expected_result: Only the new profile contract is accepted during normal operation, and role/session legality is enforced per DEC-BDL-047 and DEC-BDL-049.
proof_cases.observable_evidence: Schema validation PASS with typed negative-case failures.
proof_cases.pass_fail_rule: PASS only when legacy lineup fallback is absent, all invalid fixtures are rejected, and explicitly disabled and omitted sessions are handled as distinct accepted cases.

method_fields.non_inference: This case asserts schema acceptance and rejection only. It does not assert that an omitted session flag means enabled or disabled, and it does not author a product default.

proof_cases.negative_or_failure_case: A profile containing an active Surveyor session, a session illegal for its role, or an invalid cadence is rejected.

proof_cases.observable_evidence: Renderer PASS receipt with output digest.
proof_cases.pass_fail_rule: PASS only for byte equality, safe escaping, visible missing and stale states, visible explicit N/A reasons, and accessible fixed structure.

proof_cases.method: preservation inspection against the frozen migration map
preconditions: test/fixtures/s1l-migration-map.json is the frozen source/destination map for S1L.
DEC-BDL-063 requires renaming existing skills and preserving file content and behavior rather than deleting and recreating them.
DEC-BDL-042 requires the prompt skill to ship unchanged.
proof_cases.stimulus_or_procedure: Inspect the frozen migration map operations, the exact packaged empty-catalog bytes, the byte-for-byte copy_unchanged operation for the prompt skill, and the post-rename skill names for Implementer, Reviewer, and Coordinator.
proof_cases.expected_result: Every migration operation is an exact rename, copy, or removal from the frozen map; the shipped catalog is empty and carries no default; the prompt skill is copied unchanged; renamed skills carry the approved names.
proof_cases.observable_evidence: Passing CMD-BDL-S1 output enumerating the frozen operations, catalog bytes, and post-rename names.
proof_cases.pass_fail_rule: PASS only when no migration operation requires a semantic edit, the prompt skill content is identical to its source, and the disappearance of an old source path is explained by an approved rename in the frozen map.

method_fields.rationale: Added in this revision so the mechanical migration slices carry an explicit preservation and output check rather than relying only on downstream schema and package cases.
method_fields.non_inference: This case checks preservation and exactness only. It does not restate or redefine any migrated skill's behavior.

proof_cases.negative_or_failure_case: An operation outside the frozen map, a prompt skill that differs from its source, a non-empty shipped catalog, or a skill left under a retired name fails the inspection.

preconditions: The DoD Manifest renderer and its model-activation contract are implemented.
The configured modeling mode for a given model row is stated by the Systems Modeler in implementation.json.dod_manifest.models and is not chosen by this plan.
proof_cases.stimulus_or_procedure: Exercise the three explicitly stated model-row states against the renderer: an activated row (selected or required) must bind a digest-checked view and renders it; a row marked not_applicable with a reason stays visible as N/A and requires no view; an explicitly inactive row (selected false and required false) requires no view and does not fail. Then exercise the failure states: an activated row whose view is missing, and an activated row whose bound digest is stale.
proof_cases.expected_result: Each state renders or fails exactly as its declared applicability requires, and the modeling mode recorded on the row is carried through to the rendered inventory without the renderer selecting or rewriting it.
proof_cases.observable_evidence: Passing CMD-BDL-MANIFEST output covering the activated, N/A, inactive, missing-view, and stale-digest cases, plus the rendered model inventory showing each row's mode, source, viewpoint, trace, limitations, and status.
proof_cases.pass_fail_rule: PASS only when a selected or required missing or stale view fails visibly, an explicit N/A row stays visible with its reason, an explicitly inactive row passes without a view, and no modeling format is required beyond what the row itself declares.

method_fields.modeling_mode_is_configurable: Modeling is configurable and optional. Where native SysML is the selected mode, the SysML model remains the semantic authority and the embedded SVG or PNG is a digest-bound human projection (DEC-BDL-048). This SEIT mandates no Mermaid, no JSON diagram dialect, and no particular tool.
method_fields.derived_view_statement: docs/architecture/bearing-process/lifecycle-context.svg and lifecycle-process-views.svg are derived views retained in the repository. They are not, and must not be presented as, a SysML model.
method_fields.non_inference: This case asserts only the explicitly stated states. It does not assert a meaning for a model row that omits both selected and required, and it does not author a product default for that case.
method_fields.rationale: Added in this revision to carry the DEC-BDL-046 model-view semantics on a case of its own, now that no standalone process HTML page exists to carry them.
method_fields.current_binding_state: Both planning model rows are currently bound through implementation.json.dod_manifest.closeout.model_views, which the implemented supplemental binding contract resolves; CMD-BDL-RENDER passes with digest sha256:c323df661ae2449e8f3f61a5548955100bcb4451b5f90724999599d7f7b6daf4. A row bound supplementally satisfies the activated-row state of this case exactly as a directly bound row does. The open item on these rows is stale descriptive metadata only (GAP-BDL-005).

proof_cases.negative_or_failure_case: An activated row with no bound view, a stale digest, or an N/A row rendered invisibly fails the manifest tests.

preconditions: The DoD Manifest has been rendered and CMD-BDL-RENDER reports byte determinism.

proof_cases.observable_evidence: An owner or human observer's recorded observation. No agent-produced substitute is accepted.
proof_cases.pass_fail_rule: Currently INCONCLUSIVE with reason visual_demonstration_unavailable. This case cannot become PASS by agent action and must not be substituted by the deterministic structural checks of SEIT-BDL-003 or SEIT-BDL-011.
